# Version 4.156.1 (Unreleased)
> **GPU rendering corrections**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.1 corrects GPU rendering and clip handling while retaining Skia m156 and the managed API surface.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct transformed curves** — Corrects transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths and corner radii, and clamps corner radii to prevent overlap. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Avoid stale Ganesh atlas work** — Empty flushes no longer leave stale token comparisons that make earlier atlas work appear pending in later flushes. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Respect Graphite clip capacity** — Counts the full effective clip stack when starting a render pass without double-counting recorded clips. Draws that cannot fit are warned about and skipped rather than exceeding pass capacity. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
